data_facts_with_para.paragraph: SINGAPORE: For the first time, Singapore’s total population has exceeded six million, mainly due to the growth in the non-resident population.

facts.fact_content: Singapore’s total population has exceeded six million.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: As of June this year, the country’s population stood at 6.04 million, a 2 per cent increase from last year.

facts.fact_content: The country’s population stood at 6.04 million.
A 2 per cent increase in population from last year.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: Of the 6.04 million, there were 4.18 million residents and about 1.86 million non-residents, which comprise the foreign workforce, migrant domestic workers, dependants and international students.

According to the report, the non-resident population jumped by about 5 per cent from last year. The increase was seen across most pass types, with work permit holders contributing most to the increase (44 per cent of non-resident population), followed by migrant domestic workers (15 per cent of non-resident population).

facts.fact_content: The non-resident population jumped by about 5 per cent from last year.
Work permit holders contribute 44 per cent of non-resident population.
Migrant domestic workers contribute 15 per cent of non-resident population.
